candidates.name: Renal Cell Carcinoma
support_spans: a right renal mass with areas of fat attenuation located in the upper pole
a fatty tumor thrombus within the right renal vein extending to its confluence with the inferior vena cava
candidates.why: The presence of a renal mass with fat attenuation and a tumor thrombus in the renal vein is suggestive of renal cell carcinoma.
